vonarmen-wq-forward-deployed-selling-for.description: Operating doctrine for AI-era enterprise sales. Use this skill whenever the work touches an account, prospect, deal, pipeline, outreach, stakeholder, sales coaching, or any decision that affects revenue — even if the user does not say "sales": account research, exec briefs, call prep, business cases, value propositions, deal reviews, forecasting, disqualification, and cross-functional pulls into a deal all qualify. Also use it when the user types any /fds command.
